name: ANA MARIA POSADA
heroSubtitle: I design calm, useful digital products — from brand and interface to Lottie motion and the code that ships them.
heroBody: Based in Vancouver, BC. Six shipped projects below — each one scannable in under a minute.
aboutBody: I'm a multidisciplinary designer in Vancouver working across product UI/UX, visual design, branding, motion, and front-end development. I care about how a product feels as much as how it works — calm layouts, warm color, and small moments of motion that make an interface feel alive.
When I'm not in Figma, I'm animating in After Effects and Lottie, or turning designs into real websites with Astro and Webflow.
servicesSubtitle: From first brand sketch to shipped, animated website.
contactBody: I'd love to hear your ideas! Let's chat about how we can work together to make your vision a reality.
